# ui::TwoWayBinding

Header: `winui/core/Property.hpp`.

```cpp
template <typename T> class TwoWayBinding
```

Derives from `ui::Binding< T >`.

What [bind()](namespace-ui.md#bind) of a non-const [Property](property.md) returns: a Binding<T> that writes back. It converts to every field a [`Binding<T>`](binding.md) does, except an editable field that can be unset (a [TwoWayField](two-way-field.md) of `std::optional<T>`). Nothing names it; a binding kept in a variable is `auto` or a [`Binding<T>`](binding.md).
